readyToFreeze: NO — presented for the owner's review ('Do NOT freeze or integrate automatically.')

phase1.model: touch = ideal + Σ σ_a · bounded(N_a) · ê_a, σ_a = k_a · vRef · D · E_B(BC, D); bounded(N) = N for |N| ≤ 1.5, else ±(1.5 + tanh(|N| − 1.5)), cap 2.5

mirror.note: exact = the same family, class and continuation time (to 1e-12 s) and the ball path mirrored to 1e-9 m; bitIdentical = no floating-point difference at all (angle wraps of mirrored values can differ in the last bit)

decisionsForOwner: keep the half-turn's 120° comfortable bound (through-stance at 150–180) or let outcomes decide
keep or drop the outside-of-foot turn (infeasible for frontal passes > ~6 m/s)
